scripts.auth:schema: vp exec auth generate --config src/better-auth/schema.ts --output migrations/0001_better-auth.sql --yes
scripts.build: vp exec astro build && node scripts/generate-csp-hashes.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:local: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply triad-better-auth --local
scripts.db:migrate:staging: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.deploy: vp run build && vp exec wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: vp run build:staging && vp exec wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.preview: vp run build && vp exec astro preview
